en.headline: Oman’s Sohar International to open Hong Kong office this week
en.dek: Sources say the Omani lender will open a representative office at Cheung Kong Center II in Central, its first presence outside the Middle East.
body: Sohar International Bank, Oman’s second-largest bank by assets, plans to open a representative office in Hong Kong this week, according to people familiar with the matter cited by the South China Morning Post.

The office will be at Cheung Kong Center II in Central. Sources said chief executive Abdulwahid Mohamed Al Murshidi is due in Hong Kong for a Thursday morning opening ceremony, and that Donald Chia will serve as chief representative. The bank did not immediately comment when asked on Tuesday.

A representative office typically handles liaison and business origination rather than taking deposits. Sohar International received initial approval from the Central Bank of Oman in late 2025 to explore a Hong Kong presence, subject to licences from Hong Kong authorities. The move would be the bank’s first expansion outside the Middle East.

zh.headline: 阿曼Sohar銀行本周擬在中環開設代表處
zh.dek: 消息指阿曼第二大銀行將於長江集團中心二期開設代表處，是該行首次在中東以外設點，開幕儀式料周四舉行。
body: 《南華早報》引述知情人士報道，阿曼按資產計第二大銀行Sohar International Bank計劃本周在香港開設代表處。
代表處位於中環長江集團中心二期。消息指行政總裁Abdulwahid Mohamed Al Murshidi將於周四上午出席開幕儀式，首席代表為Donald Chia。銀行周二未有即時回應查詢。
代表處一般負責聯絡及開拓業務，而非吸收存款。該行2025年底已獲阿曼中央銀行原則批准探討在港設點，仍須取得香港監管許可。若成事，將是該行首次在中東以外開設據點。
